StepDescription: Launch Lorenzo Application
Login with valid credentials
Wait for home page to load
-- NAVIGATE TO EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT --
Click on My Work tab to expand navigation
Wait for My Work navigation to expand
Click on Emergency Department link
Wait for Department Map to load
Select the Emergency Care Ward from the department map
Click OK to confirm ward selection and open EC Whiteboard
Wait for EC Whiteboard to load
-- CREATE ATTENDANCE --
Click Create Attendance from context pane to begin attendance creation
Wait for patient basic search form to load
Generate random surname for new patient registration
Enter generated random surname in patient search field
Click Find to search for existing patient records
Wait for patient search results to load
Click Registration link to open new patient registration form
Wait for patient registration form to load
Enter city in patient registration address field
Select country in patient registration form
Click Finish Now to complete patient registration and trigger NHS allocation
Wait for NHS allocation confirmation prompt
Click Yes to confirm NHS number allocation for the new patient
Wait for visitor status question prompt
Click No to confirm patient is not a visitor (UK patient with NHS number)
Wait for Create Attendance form to load after NHS allocation
Verify NHS Number has been allocated - Create Attendance form is loaded confirming patient registration
-- FILL CREATE ATTENDANCE DETAILS --
Enter arrival date and time for the EC attendance
Enter presenting complaint for the EC attendance
Select attendance type for the EC attendance
Click icon to search and select responsible care provider
Wait for care provider search form to load
Enter responsible care provider surname
Enter responsible care provider forename
Click Find Now to search for the care provider
Wait for care provider search results to load
Click OK to select the care provider from search results
Wait for Create Attendance form to reload after care provider selection
Select attendance source
Select consultation medium for the attendance
Select who patient is assigned to
Select mode of arrival for the EC attendance
Click Finish to validate and save EC attendance details
Wait for EC Whiteboard to reload after attendance creation
Validate attendance created: Verify patient row is visible on EC Whiteboard
-- MODIFY ATTENDANCE --
Search for the patient on EC Whiteboard by surname
Click search icon to execute whiteboard patient search
Wait for whiteboard search results to load
Select the patient row on EC Whiteboard to enable context pane actions
Wait for context pane to update with patient-specific actions
Click Modify Attendance from context pane
Wait for Modify Attendance form to load
Select reason for modifying the attendance
Update attendance type as part of modification
Click Finish to validate and save Modify Attendance changes
Wait for EC Whiteboard to reload after modification
Validate Modify Attendance: Verify patient is still on EC Whiteboard after modification
-- TRIAGE AND STREAM --
Search for patient on EC Whiteboard before Triage
Click search icon to find the patient
Wait for patient search results
Select the patient row to activate context pane actions
Wait for context pane to update
Click Triage and Stream from context pane
Wait for Triage and Stream form to load
Click Find icon to search and select chief complaint term
Wait for chief complaint search dialog to load
Enter search term for chief complaint
Click search icon to execute chief complaint search
Wait for chief complaint search results
Click OK to select the chief complaint term from search results
Wait for Triage form to reload after chief complaint selection
Click icon to search and select triaged by care provider
Wait for care provider search form to load for triaged by
Enter triaged by care provider surname
Enter triaged by care provider forename
Click Find Now to search for the triaged by care provider
Wait for care provider search results
Click OK to select the triaged by care provider
Wait for Triage form to reload after triaged by selection
Enter triaged on date and time
Select triage category
Click Finish to validate and save triage details
Wait for EC Whiteboard to reload after triage
Validate triage recorded: Verify patient is visible on EC Whiteboard with triage status
-- MODIFY TRIAGE AND STREAM --
Search for patient on EC Whiteboard before Modify Triage
Click search icon to find the patient
Wait for patient search results on whiteboard
Select the patient row to enable context pane actions
Wait for context pane to update
Click Modify Triage and Stream from context pane
Wait for Modify Triage and Stream form to load
Update analgesia details for Modify Triage
Select reason for modifying triage details
Click Finish to validate and save Modify Triage changes
Wait for EC Whiteboard to reload after triage modification
Validate Modify Triage: Verify patient is visible on EC Whiteboard after triage modification
-- SEEN --
Search for patient on EC Whiteboard before Seen
Click search icon to find patient for Seen action
Wait for patient search results on whiteboard
Select the patient row to enable Seen context action
Wait for context pane to update
Click Seen from context pane to record patient seen by clinician
Wait for Seen form to load
Click icon to search and select Seen By care provider
Wait for care provider search form to load for Seen By
Enter Seen By care provider surname
Enter Seen By care provider forename
Click Find Now to search for Seen By care provider
Wait for care provider search results for Seen By
Click OK to select the Seen By care provider
Wait for Seen form to reload after care provider selection
Enter seen start date and time
Click Finish to validate and save Seen details
Wait for EC Whiteboard to reload after Seen recording
Validate Seen: Verify patient is on EC Whiteboard with Seen status recorded
-- DECISION TO ADMIT --
Search for patient on EC Whiteboard before Decision to Admit
Click search icon to find patient for Decision to Admit
Wait for patient search results on whiteboard
Select the patient row to enable Decision to Admit context action
Wait for context pane to update with Decision to Admit action
Click Decision to Admit from context pane
Wait for Record Decision to Admit form to load
Enter Decision to Admit date and time
Click icon to search and select Requested By care provider
Wait for care provider search form for Requested By
Enter Requested By care provider surname
Enter Requested By care provider forename
Click Find Now to search for Requested By care provider
Wait for care provider search results for Requested By
Click OK to select the Requested By care provider
Wait for DTA form to reload after Requested By selection
Select associate referral type for Decision to Admit
Select referred to type for Decision to Admit
Click icon to search and select specialty for admission
Wait for specialty search form to load
Enter specialty clinical unit name to search
Click Find to search for the specialty
Wait for specialty search results
Click OK to select the specialty from search results
Wait for DTA form to reload after specialty selection
Click Finish to save Decision to Admit details
Wait for Perform Create Booking Request confirmation dialog
Click Yes to select Perform Create Booking Request action
Wait for Booking Request form to load
Click icon to search and select Requested By care provider for Booking Request
Wait for care provider search form for Booking Request Requested By
Enter Booking Request Requested By care provider surname
Enter Booking Request Requested By care provider forename
Click Find Now to search for Booking Request Requested By care provider
Wait for care provider search results for Booking Request
Click OK to select the Booking Request Requested By care provider
Wait for Booking Request form to reload after care provider selection
Select preferred ward for the Booking Request
Click Finish to complete Booking Request creation
Wait for EC Whiteboard to reload after Decision to Admit and Booking Request
Validate Decision to Admit saved: Verify patient is on EC Whiteboard with DTA recorded
-- NAVIGATE TO IP WARD - VALIDATE DECISION TO ADMIT --
Click Inpatient from context pane to navigate to IP Ward view
Wait for IP Ward view to load
Click Bed Manager View tab in IP Ward
Wait for Bed Manager View to load
Validate Decision to Admit visible in IP Ward: Verify Bed Manager View tab is loaded confirming DTA booking request is present
-- RETURN TO EMERGENCY WARD --
Click My Work tab to navigate back to Emergency Department
Wait for My Work navigation to expand
Click Emergency Department to return to the EC ward selection
Wait for Department Map to load
Re-select the Emergency Care Ward from department map
Click OK to open EC Whiteboard
Wait for EC Whiteboard to load after returning from IP Ward
Search for patient on EC Whiteboard to prepare for Close Attendance
Click search icon to find patient on EC Whiteboard
Wait for whiteboard search results
Select the patient row to enable Close Attendance context action
Wait for context pane to update with Close Attendance action
-- CLOSE ATTENDANCE --
Click Close Attendance from context pane
Wait for Close Attendance form to load
Enter treatment completed on date and time
Click icon to search and select Authorised By care provider
Wait for care provider search form for Authorised By
Enter Authorised By care provider surname
Enter Authorised By care provider forename
Click Find Now to search for Authorised By care provider
Wait for care provider search results for Authorised By
Click OK to select the Authorised By care provider
Wait for Close Attendance form to reload after Authorised By selection
Check Perform Actual Disposal Now checkbox to enable disposal fields
Wait for disposal fields to become active
Enter disposal date and time
Select discharge status for the closed attendance
Select principal reason for attendance closure
Click Finish Now to complete Close Attendance and validate all details
Wait for EC Whiteboard to reload after attendance closure
Validate Close Attendance: Verify EC Whiteboard search field is accessible confirming return to whiteboard after closure
-- LOGOUT --
Click Logout button to exit Lorenzo application
Confirm logout by clicking Yes on confirmation dialog
